item.title: Slingshots Add-On
item.creator: Polymaps
item.description:
Add a new vanilla-friendly ranged weapon type to your worlds with the Slingshot Add-On!

- Wooden Slingshots are a cheap early-game alternative to the Bow!
- Shoot Pebbles crafted from Cobblestone!
- Breeze Slingshots are an upgraded tier that can shoot Copper Balls!
- Shoot Volleys to pierce multiple targets in an area, perfect for crowds of mobs!
- By Polymaps
item.changelog:
[Minor Update]
- Fixed a bug where players were constantly teleported
- Fixed a bug where other players were immune to projectile damage
- Crafting recipes for Pebbles and Copper Balls now produce 4 ammo
- General improvements to projectiles, visuals, and performance

faqEntries.heading: Is this Add-On compatible with other Add-Ons?
faqEntries.content: Yes! This Add-On should be compatible with most Add-Ons.

faqEntries.heading: Can I enchant the Slingshots?
faqEntries.content: Currently, Slingshots can only be enchanted with Unbreaking from levels 1-3.

faqEntries.heading: What's the difference between Pebbles and Copper Balls?
faqEntries.content: Any Slingshot can fire Pebbles, but they deal less damage than Copper Balls. To fire Copper Balls, you must use a Breeze Slingshot.

faqEntries.heading: What are Pebble Volleys and Copper Ball Volleys?
faqEntries.content: Pebbles and Copper Balls deal single-target damage with each shot. In contrast, Pebble Volleys and Copper Ball Volleys strike multiple enemies across a wider area, making them ideal for crowd control.

item.howToTitle: How to enable this Add-On in your own world:

howToEntries.heading: Step 1: Ensure the Add-On is downloaded
howToEntries.content: Once purchased, download the Add-On to your device directly from the Marketplace. Select My Library at the top of the Marketplace screen, and under the Owned section, click Add-Ons to filter your items. Locate your newly purchased Add-On, then click Download to save it to your device.

howToEntries.heading: Step 2A: Enable the Add-On in an existing world
howToEntries.content: From the Main Menu, select Play and locate your existing world. Open its world settings by clicking the Edit icon right beside the world's name. If you wish to create a backup, go to the General section and choose Duplicate World. Next, scroll down the settings menu, select Behavior Packs, and switch to the Available tab to view your installed Add-Ons. Finally, find the Add-On you want to use and click Activate to add it to your world.

howToEntries.heading: Step 2B: Enable the Add-On in a new world
howToEntries.content: To enable the Add-On in a new world, select Play from the Main Menu, and then select Create World. Scroll down the world settings menu, select Behavior Packs, and find the Add-On in your list of Available Add-Ons. Click Activate to enable the Add-On, and then select Create World after any other changes you wish to make.

howToEntries.heading: Step 3: Obtain the Guide Book
howToEntries.content: When you first join the world with the Add-On enabled, you should receive a Guide Book. If you lose this Guide Book, another can be crafted at any time with a Book and Leather.
